rules.noNewObjects: only the 78 places of block 2 sections 1-5; each task opens the map the place was taught on (section 1: blank map with the Ural; rivers map; mountains map; capitals map with rivers for countries)
rules.lesson: about 10 tasks, 3-5 minutes; mistakes come back at the end until answered correctly; about 60% of the asked places are the child's weakest (S.weak)
rules.crimea: Crimea never appears in country tasks (Svetlana, 26.10.2026); a tap on Crimea or Kosovo answers no country
rules.caucasus: the Caucasus keeps its disputed note and is tied to no country
rules.bern: Switzerland's capital is shown as Bern with the approved card wording: by law there is no capital, Bern is the federal city (29.10.2026)
rules.relations: pairs and true/false use only approved relations; crosses (river -> country) come from data/maps/europe-countries-5.json rivers[].crosses, approved with section 5; in pairs no row's answer is also true for another row's place
rules.approval: each relation, true/false pair, select-all task, trap and record: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over the item without its approval (tools/approve.mjs); an item shows only when approved
